page_title: CEL 0-2 GET | Celta Vigo v Getafe 17/08/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+9' Iosu Galech is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+7' Celta Vigo have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
90+6' The corner is swung in but Celta Vigo can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away. Celta Vigo get a corner.
90+5' Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo) gets to the rebound just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by one of the defending players.
90+1' Marcos Alonso (Celta Vigo) is booked.
90' 8 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
87' Javier Rodriguez (Celta Vigo) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Iosu Galech had an easy-decision to make.
87' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Celta Vigo.
87' Oscar Mingueza (Celta Vigo) takes the corner, but the goalkeeper jumps and gathers the ball.
86' The ball is cleared after Bryan Zaragoza (Celta Vigo) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. It will be a corner kick for Celta Vigo.
83' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Getafe comes to nothing.
82' Claudio Giraldez has decided to substitute Yoel Lago and he is replaced by Pablo Duran (Celta Vigo).
81' David Soria (Getafe) picks up a caution.
78' Alex Sola (Getafe) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Adrian Liso.
77' Bryan Zaragoza (Celta Vigo) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.
72' 0 - 2 Christantus Uche (Getafe) beats the offside trap and bears down on goal. With just the keeper to beat he coolly shoots past him from the edge of the box.

72' Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo) blew a promising chance when he got to a rebound just outside the penalty area. He struck it towards the left side of the target, but David Soria pulled off a nice save to stop the attempt.
71' Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo) has an effort from distance and sends the ball towards the bottom right corner, but the goalkeeper is equal to it.
67' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Borja Iglesias (Celta Vigo) will replace Ferran Jutgla.
65' Celta Vigo take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
65' Ferran Jutgla (Celta Vigo) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. Celta Vigo have a corner.
64' Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo) takes the corner kick but the ball only finds the head of an opponent.
64' An attempted cross from Marcos Alonso (Celta Vigo) is cleared. Celta Vigo earn a corner.
63' Adrian Liso (Getafe) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
62' The game is interrupted now, Adrian Liso (Getafe) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
61' Marcos Alonso (Celta Vigo) takes a mid-range free kick and the effort crashes into the defensive wall.
60' Christantus Uche (Getafe) is penalised after knocking an opponent down. Celta Vigo earn a free kick which could lead to a goal-scoring opportunity.
57' Substitution. Jones El Abdellaoui (Celta Vigo) has come on for Williot Swedberg.
57' Here is a change. Fran Beltran is going off and Claudio Giraldez gives the last tactical orders to Hugo Sotelo (Celta Vigo).
57' A substitution has been made. Mihailo Ristic goes off and Bryan Zaragoza (Celta Vigo) comes on.
56' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Williot Swedberg (Celta Vigo) was quite harsh and Iosu Galech didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
53' Davinchi (Getafe) whips the ball in from the long-range free kick, but the first man gets it clear.
52' Javier Rodriguez (Celta Vigo) brings down his opponent with a very late tackle. That's a free kick to Getafe.
51' The attendance is 23530.
49' Williot Swedberg (Celta Vigo) brings his opponent down with a tackle and Iosu Galech blows his whistle for a foul.
47' 0 - 1 Goal! Christantus Uche produces a great pass that finds Adrian Liso (Getafe) inside the penalty area, who takes advantage of the situation to rifle a shot into the bottom right corner. 0:1.
47' Ilaix Moriba (Celta Vigo) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+3' Iosu Galech has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+2' Ismael Bekhoucha (Getafe) is penalised for a foul. Iosu Galech had a clear view and blows his whistle.
45' There will be a minimum of 2 min. of added time.
45' Oscar Mingueza (Celta Vigo) takes the free kick but it is cleared by the first defender.
45' Christantus Uche (Getafe) goes into the book for a horrible tackle. A yellow card is necessary in this case.
44' Christantus Uche (Getafe) brings an opponent down and Iosu Galech interrupts the game. Celta Vigo get a free kick.
41' Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo) puts a cross into the box from the free kick, but the defender gets there first.
40' Ismael Bekhoucha (Getafe) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent. Celta Vigo will take a free kick.
39' Christantus Uche (Getafe) pounced on a rebound on the edge of the box and his shot goes a whisker over the crossbar.
38' Iosu Galech couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Williot Swedberg (Celta Vigo) and blew his whistle.
36' Getafe work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.

36' Ismael Bekhoucha (Getafe) sends a long crossfield pass searching out one of his teammates, but his effort comes to nothing and they lose possession. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Getafe.
33' The corner from Oscar Mingueza (Celta Vigo) is intercepted by the defence.
33' Williot Swedberg (Celta Vigo) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. Celta Vigo have been awarded a corner kick.
30' A wild pass somehow finds Oscar Mingueza (Celta Vigo) in space, he steadies himself and shoots from mid-range but sends it just over the bar.
28' Mario Martin (Getafe) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
28' Mario Martin (Getafe) goes down under a challenge in the box, but the ref immediately waves away the appeals from all players.
26' Fran Beltran (Celta Vigo) makes a strong challenge and Iosu Galech blows for a foul.
23' The ref blows his whistle and we are going to have a so-called cooling break due to the high temperature.
21' Oscar Mingueza (Celta Vigo) takes the corner but it's cleared.

21' Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo) must feel embarrassed now. He received a killer pass, but his shot from the six-yard box was a disaster. He miskicked and made it very easy for David Soria to get hold of the ball. The linesman points to the corner flag, Celta Vigo are going to take it.
20' Rough tackle by Juan Antonio Iglesias Sanchez (Getafe). The referee blows his whistle for a foul.
19' Williot Swedberg (Celta Vigo) makes a driving run into the box but he cannot work any space for a shot. The ball goes out of play and Getafe will have a goal kick.
15' A cross from a corner kick by Celta Vigo is too strong and the ball goes well out of play. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Getafe.
14' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Mihailo Ristic (Celta Vigo) is thwarted and cleared to safety. Celta Vigo have been awarded a corner kick.
13' That's a well-taken pass by Mauro Arambarri (Getafe). He unleashes a strike from the edge of the box, but blazes it high over the bar.
13' The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Getafe.
12' Ismael Bekhoucha (Getafe) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted. The ball is out of play. Getafe win a corner kick.
11' Ferran Jutgla (Celta Vigo) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Iosu Galech blows his whistle for a foul.
7' Oscar Mingueza (Celta Vigo) whips a long ball in from the free kick which is intercepted by David Soria.
6' Davinchi (Getafe) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Iosu Galech blows for a foul.
4' Mauro Arambarri (Getafe) gets on the end of a pass and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's blocked by one of the defending players.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Getafe will have the kick-off.
Today's referee will be Iosu Galech.
